test_title: PYST 34: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India mentions the Fundamental Duty of defending the country and rendering national service when called upon to do so?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 51A (d)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 51A (d)** of the Constitution of India mandates that it is the **Fundamental Duty** of every Indian citizen to "defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so."
 
• Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution by the **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**, based on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.
 
• These duties are enshrined under **Part IVA** of the Constitution.
 
• The objective of incorporating Fundamental Duties is to remind citizens of their moral obligations toward the nation and to uphold the spirit of patriotism.
 
• There are currently **11 Fundamental Duties** listed in Article 51A of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**

 
 
• It is also known as the "Mini Constitution" of India due to the significant changes it brought to the Constitution.
 
• It introduced **Fundamental Duties**, added the words "Socialist," "Secular," and "Integrity" to the Preamble, and curtailed the power of the judiciary, among other changes.
 
 
 
• **Swaran Singh Committee**
 
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee was constituted in 1976 to recommend the inclusion of Fundamental Duties in the Constitution.
 
• It was named after Swaran Singh, the then Minister of External Affairs.
 
 
 
• **Fundamental Duties**
 
 
• The Fundamental Duties are non-justiciable, meaning they cannot be enforced by the courts.
 
• They serve as a moral code of conduct for citizens to contribute positively to society and the nation.
 
 
 
• **Part IVA of the Constitution**
 
 
• Part IVA was added to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.
 
• It contains only one Article, Article 51A, which enumerates the Fundamental Duties.
